name: Create a Robot Fighter
desc:
🤖 Build your own robot and make it the strongest fighter in the world! 🥊

⚙️ PULL THE LEVER – Roll robot parts at your own spin pillar. Will you get a Common… or a super rare Apex part?
🔧 BUILD – Put head, body and legs together on your charging bed, wire it up and power it on!
💪 TRAIN – Send your robot to the punching bag and watch it level up – all the way to Level 9999!
🏆 FIGHT – Your robot battles endless waves of bots in your own ring. Every round gets harder – and pays more cash!

✨ FEATURES
• 30+ robots with unique looks and special abilities
• 7 rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary, Mythic & Apex
• Upgrade your Luck to roll rarer parts
• Rebirth for more cash – and your plot gets an epic new look every time!
• Leaderboards: most rounds, rebirths, money & playtime

👍 Like the game & ⭐ favorite it to get updates!
